Prospective Graduate Students
Explore MEng, MASc and PhD programs
Dalhousie offers graduate level studies in both Civil and Mineral Resource Engineering. Whether you are interested in research and development, or gaining more knowledge for the hands-on aspects of day-to-day design and practice, our graduate level courses will provide you with expertise and knowledge.

Admission Queries - how to apply
CRE Supporting documents:
Unofficial academic transcripts for each post-secondary institution you have attended. Please include degree certificates if degree conferral is not stated on your transcript.
Two Confidential Letters of Reference. See the Faculty of Graduate Studies website for more information on the Electronic Reference (e-ref) system.
Personal Statement
C.V. (Resume)
English Language Competency-If you speak English as an additional language, results to verify your English proficiency must be provided to the Faculty of Graduate Studies before you start your program. You will not be able to register for classes until your ESL scores are verified. To do this: Send your verifiable ESL test results as PDF documents to graduate.studies@dal.ca. Request your testing centre make your results accessible to Dalhousie University.
Proof of financial support.
Be sure that all of your documents have been submitted before the application deadline. Applications will not be reviewed until all documents have been received. Once accepted, students must confirm or decline the offer of admission by emailing the CRE Office at cregrad.admission@dal.ca
